name: LDView
blurb: LDView is a real-time 3D viewer for displaying LDraw models using hardware-accellerated 3D graphics.
description:
LDView is a real-time 3D viewer for displaying LDraw models
using hardware-accellerated 3D graphics. For information on LDraw,
please visit www.ldraw.org, the centralized LDraw information
site.

The program can read LDraw LDR/DAT files as well as MPD
files. It then allows you to rotate the model around to any angle
with the mouse.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
